summary: Add repeatable --modifier <modifierId>:<optionId> flag (builds selectionsHash) and fix --replace-piece to accept UUID string piece ids; emit valid JSON on dry-run/preview paths under --json/--agent.
reason: Items with a required modifier (e.g. Choose Protein) are rejected by the API without selectionsHash; Forkable piece ids are UUID strings not integers; and the dry-run/preview paths printed prose under --json, breaking agents and the dogfood json_fidelity check.
validated_outcome: meal set-all --json --dry-run now emits valid JSON ({dry_run:true,...}); burrito order with --modifier 16:10 placed successfully live.
